rule: Step B pilot (seed 42), fixed before training. A retrained model goes to a 3-seed final only if, on the 12 GalaxyPPG test people (never trained on; 3 halvings), its mean 'indistinguishable' exceeds the app PhysioMix's by more than 2x the larger halving SD, its Q is lower than the app PhysioMix's, and its median |rate error| is not worse by more than 2 bpm; AND on the original validation it passes every gate with S_arm <= 0.559 and wrist Q <= 0.587 (no regression beyond round 9's seed spread). Otherwise the app models stay.
